descriptions.text: Make your own foil accents. Cut with punches or Big Shot. Foil on one side. * 2 sheets * Copper * 12" x 12" (30.5 x 30.5 cm) * Acid free

images.description: A folded sheet of metallic copper or rose gold cardstock or specialty paper, displaying a smooth, brushed finish with subtle sheen. The product is shown against a light neutral background, with the fold creating a peak that demonstrates the material's quality and reflective properties.

descriptions.text: Make windows in boxes or cards, use with Shaker Frames, or cut clear accents or boxes with select Big Shot dies. Can also be stamped with StazOn Ink. * 2 sheets * 12" x 12" * Clear

images.description: Three layered cardstock or paper squares in varying shades of cream and beige, arranged in a rotated diamond orientation. The squares appear to show different tones and textures of neutral-colored cardstock, demonstrating color variation or product options.

A collection of metal cutting dies featuring hot air balloon and cloud themed designs. The set includes one detailed hot air balloon, two solid hot air balloons of different sizes, various cloud shapes in small and large sizes, and rectangular banner shapes. All pieces have silver-gray metal outlines and are arranged on a light beige background.

A collection of metal cutting dies featuring dragonfly designs in various sizes. The set includes multiple dragonfly shapes with intricate wing details, ranging from small to large, plus a butterfly-shaped die. All pieces are silver-toned metal with decorative vein patterns on the wings.

A collection of decorative outline designs featuring three oval-shaped frames with different interior patterns (blank, radiating lines with banner, and sunburst with botanical elements) and coordinating embellishments including stars, clouds, and floral sprigs. The designs appear to be die-cut templates or stamp designs printed in blue ink on a cream-colored background.

A collection of metal cutting dies featuring various decorative shapes and patterns including a wavy-edged tray, hexagon with floral design, oval tag, rectangular boxes with textured patterns, and small envelope/label components. The dies display intricate details such as flowers, dots, cross-hatching, and geometric designs suitable for cardmaking and paper crafting.

descriptions.text: Use Palette Knives to apply Embossing Paste. Easy as 1, 2, 3! * 3 knives: 1 offset trowel, 1 offset diamond trowel, 1 scotty knife.

images.description: Three white plastic palette knives or spreaders with flat, angled heads and round handles featuring small holes at the base. The tools are arranged diagonally on a light beige textured surface, showing their varied blade shapes designed for crafting applications.

A tan/beige perforated board or mat with regularly spaced circular holes arranged in a grid pattern. A hand is shown scraping white material (possibly embossing powder or similar crafting substance) off the board's surface using a white scraper tool.
